name: Nila 0.7.0 — Personal Workspace
body:
# Nila 0.7.0 — Shared Models

- **Fast**: `qwen3:0.6b` for quick, lightweight tasks.
- **Medium**: `qwen3:1.7b` for balanced everyday help.
- **Smart / Current**: `qwen3:4b`, the new-install default for more demanding tasks.

A central model service powers Web, CLI and Telegram. Switch without restarting. Existing custom selections remain; missing models are reported with an install command. Model names can be remapped in the Models dashboard. Model size does not guarantee speed or correctness on every device.

CLI: `nila model`, `nila model use fast|medium|current`, or an installed model name. Telegram: `/model`, `/model fast|medium|current`.

The composer uses icons for search, thinking, microphone, speech-stop and models, with accessible labels and tooltips. The supplied Nila lotus logo appears in the sidebar, message avatars and favicon.

Each request picks one thinking phrase and animates dots until response text begins. Telegram edits one temporary message into the answer, with throttled partial updates. Failed or cancelled requests stop the animation.

Public web questions no longer inherit the user's profile or an old Nila developer answer. Identity shortcuts match direct questions about Nila only. Founder/creator lookups trigger web retrieval when search is enabled. Search Off still performs no retrieval; provider availability remains dependent on network access.

Memory now reports personal facts, pending suggestions, accepted Learning Lab lessons, saved web topics, recall switches and recent Learning Lab errors. Opening it recovers source references from older completed answers once, without recreating intentionally forgotten items afterward. Web evidence and accepted lessons stay encrypted and can be used offline. Uncertain/failed Learning Lab reviews are not silently treated as learned facts.

Gemini still receives only consented Learning Lab exchanges, never ordinary chats, profile, files or personal memory. These improvements use saved reference retrieval, not model-weight training.

Validation covers mocked Ollama routing for all three profiles, persistence, missing-model errors, external founder isolation, old evidence recovery, Telegram indicator lifecycle, and browser streaming/controls. Actual model throughput, microphone hardware and a live Telegram account require testing on the user's device.

name: Nila 0.6.0 — Personal Workspace
body:
# Nila 0.6.0 — Personal Workspace

## Updates

- Updates now follow stable GitHub Releases. Managed Windows updates download a prebuilt executable, verify its GitHub SHA-256 digest, smoke-test its version, and switch installations under the existing exclusive lock. Failed checks retain the current installation. No local Python/Node build is needed for subsequent updates.
- `nila upadte`, `nila updatw` and `nila udpate` are accepted as aliases of `nila update`.
- Publication runs only after Windows and Linux tests and binary builds succeed. Existing version releases are never overwritten.

## Chat and interface

- Sources opens a detail panel and closes on a second click, Escape, or clicking outside. Source URLs are no longer appended as a separate generated footer.
- Copy, regeneration, voting and read-aloud controls sit below the message content. Sidebar temporary-chat and preference checkbox layouts are corrected.
- Attached files stay visible when reopening chats, can be removed, and can be sent without typing a question. Nila summarizes file-only submissions; extracted text is supplied to the local model.
- Conversation names use the first completed assistant answer. Developer questions have a direct Nadeem/GitHub response.
- Paired underline markers render around nested emphasis without exposing raw formatting. Code operators remain unchanged.

## Personal workspace

- Models dashboard lists installed Ollama models and supports refresh, download, and load-and-use. Selection changes only after successful model loading.
- Ten selectable local instruction skills, plus Markdown import, inspection, disabling and deletion. CLI: `nila skills list`, `nila skills add file.md`, `nila skills use ID`, `nila skills off ID`.
- Goals, tone and preferred answer detail guide relevant local replies. Automatic personal-fact extraction still respects memory review and sensitive-data exclusions.
- Successful web-assisted answers save encrypted, dated evidence for later offline use; inspect and delete it in Workspace → Knowledge. Learning Lab continues to save reviewed lessons when enabled. These are retrieval notes, not model-weight training or verified truth.
- Quick/deep search skips ordinary stable questions. Explicit search requests and freshness keywords trigger retrieval; this is a keyword heuristic, not a guarantee that a model knows an answer. Use “search …” to force lookup.
- Skills and cached evidence are included in encrypted backups. Older backups remain importable.

## Telegram and voice

- `/search off|quick|deep`, `/think low|medium|high`, `/status` and `/new` controls.
- Repeated typing indicator, animated status and elapsed time while generating; Sources button opens reference details. Only the configured private owner can use the bot.
- Web read-aloud uses installed local system voices. Microphone input requires a browser with on-device speech recognition and an installed language pack. Unsupported browsers show an inline explanation; audio is not silently routed to a cloud recognizer. Stop microphone and Stop speech controls are provided.

Windows CLI voice: `nila speak "Hello"` reads text with an installed offline Windows voice; `nila listen` transcribes one utterance (30-second timeout). A Windows speech language pack and microphone permission are required. Recognition transcribes text only; it does not automatically submit a question. Other operating systems show a supported-platform explanation.

## Privacy and limits

Gemini receives only explicitly consented Learning Lab topic exchanges, never ordinary chat history, profile, attachments, custom skills or personal memory. Telegram uses Telegram's network and requires Nila running on the laptop. Search queries go to public search providers when used. No publisher code-signing certificate is bundled; Windows application-control decisions remain in force.

name: Nila v0.5.0 — Personal Workspace & Telegram
body:
# Nila v0.5.0 — Personal Workspace & Telegram

A refreshed personal assistant experience with improved conversations,
local personalization, file attachments and private Telegram access.

## New Features

- Redesigned Web UI with dark/light themes and a collapsible sidebar.
- Separate Explore and History navigation.
- Contextual follow-up questions based on the current conversation.
- Regenerate an answer in place with optional instructions.
- Low, Medium and High thinking levels.
- Installed Ollama model selection inside the composer.
- Local PDF and text-file attachments with relevant excerpt retrieval.
- Projects with dedicated instructions, documents and conversations.
- Memory inbox to approve, edit or reject suggested memories.
- Temporary chats held in RAM without persistent conversation records.
- Password-encrypted workspace backup and restore.
- Private Telegram bot connection restricted to a configured user ID.
- Setup checks, compact Web view and managed Windows rollback.

## Conversation Improvements

- User and assistant messages appear on opposite sides.
- Search, thinking, model and attachment controls share one composer.
- Quick and Deep search automatically use the current question.
- Clickable source links and a Sources & context panel.
- Improved Markdown rendering for headings, bold, italic and code.
- Copy controls for prompts and responses.
- Thumbs-up/down feedback influences future local response context.
- Normal follow-up messages continue the existing conversation.
- Inline notices and confirmations replace browser dialogs.

## CLI Improvements

- Colorful Nila welcome banner.
- Animated thinking and progress indicators.
- Rendered Markdown responses.
- Interactive shortcuts for thinking, search, attachments,
  regeneration and feedback.

## Learning Lab

- Gemini asks the opening topic question.
- The local model answers.
- Gemini reviews the answer and explains corrections.
- The local model revises or continues to a related question.
- Visible progress, transcript, time limits and Stop control.

Personal chats, profile, memories, attachments and feedback are
excluded from Gemini study requests. Explicitly entered study content
is shared with Gemini.

Saved lessons improve retrieved context; they do not retrain model weights.

## Fixes

- Fixed the composer refilling with an already submitted question.
- Fixed pending follow-up generation blocking a new message.
- Preserved original answers when regeneration fails or is cancelled.
- Improved temporary-chat and project-document isolation.
- Retained the Windows short-path installer fix for dependency errors.

## Removed

- Notes and Tasks interfaces.
- Scheduled automations.
- Written-feedback controls.
- Separate Web search query input.

Existing legacy data is retained for backup compatibility.
The background worker now supports the optional Telegram connection.

## Security & Privacy

- Telegram tokens are encrypted and excluded from backups/status output.
- Telegram personal-memory sharing is off by default.
- Only the configured private Telegram sender is accepted.
- Temporary chats and attachments are excluded from saved backups.
- Restore disables Telegram and automatic updates.
- Local API remains restricted to loopback.

## Validation

- 54 automated tests passed.
- TypeScript and Vite production build passed.
- Chromium desktop/mobile conversation checks passed.
- Simulated Learning Lab and Telegram checks passed.
- Linux standalone binary and packaged PDF extraction passed.

Actual Windows installation and live Gemini/Telegram integrations
were not tested in this environment.

## Update

Run:

    nila update

Restart Nila after the update completes.

Managed Windows updates follow GitHub main commits, independently
of GitHub Releases.

## Model Support

Recommended starter model: llama3.2:1b.
Other compatible installed Ollama models can be selected.

Thinking behavior depends on model capabilities. Telegram, Gemini
and Web search require internet.

---
Developed by Nadeem: https://github.com/nadeemmhdm
License: MIT

name: Nila v0.4.0 — Web Search & Smarter Conversations
body:
## Nila Personal Assistant v0.4.0

This update adds opt-in web search, local response feedback, improved conversation controls and a Windows installer path fix.

### Web Search
- Off: no web search requests; the default mode.
- Quick: one lookup with up to four sources.
- Deep: three query perspectives with up to eight deduplicated sources.
- Open-source DDGS integration.
- Optional separate public search query.
- Source links included with responses.
- Clear timeout and no-result errors.

Search uses result snippets rather than full-page research. Saved chats, profiles, memories and feedback are excluded from search queries.

### Conversation Improvements
- Copy buttons for user prompts and AI responses.
- Edit and regenerate a prompt in the same conversation.
- Replacement of the previous answer and dependent later turns.
- Continue-response control and saved-conversation resume.
- Additional interactive CLI shortcuts.

### Local Feedback
- Thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings.
- Optional written corrections or style guidance.
- Encrypted feedback storage.
- Automatic use of relevant feedback in future local chat context.
- Clearable ratings and guidance.

Feedback adapts future prompts; it does not retrain model weights.

### Interface
- Refined streaming and message animations.
- Rendered headings, bold, italic, underline, tables and code.
- Reduced-motion support.
- Raw HTML and external Markdown images remain disabled.

### Privacy
- Strengthened Learning Lab isolation.
- Personal chats, profiles, memories, notes and feedback are excluded from both Learning Lab model prompts and Gemini requests.
- Added privacy regression tests.

### Windows Installer Fix
- Shortened source and virtual-environment build paths.
- Addresses the reported PyInstaller dependency path-length failure.
- Added a Windows-specific dependency-installation regression check.

### Validation
- 37 Python tests passed.
- TypeScript and production Web UI build passed.
- Browser checks passed for copy, feedback, editing, continuation and mobile layout.
- Linux standalone executable built successfully.

### Known Limitations
- Windows installation was not tested end-to-end in the development environment.
- Search providers can return timeouts or no results.
- Live Gemini and real Ollama response quality were not validated.

name: Nila v0.3.0 — Gemini Learning Lab
body:
## Nila Personal Assistant v0.3.0

This update introduces an optional Learning Lab where a local Ollama model discusses topics with a Gemini reviewer.

### Learning Lab
- Visible local-model answers, Gemini reviews and correction cycles.
- Topic and optional description input.
- Configurable session duration and round limits.
- Stop control.
- Encrypted discussion transcripts.
- Saved study notes for relevant future conversations.

### Gemini Integration
- Encrypted API-key storage.
- Available-model discovery.
- Explicit cloud-sharing acknowledgement.
- Quota and error handling without automatic retries.

### Improved Personalization
- Student, Employee and other position-based profiles.
- Student course and completion-year fields.
- Employee company and job-role fields.
- Removed the college question.

### Simpler CLI
- Interactive chat without repeated commands.
- Plain-text one-shot questions.
- `/help`, `/model` and guided `/learn` shortcuts.

### Models & License
- `llama3.2:1b` remains the recommended starting model.
- Other compatible Ollama chat models are supported.
- Added the MIT license.

### Privacy & Learning Scope
Only explicitly supplied Learning Lab content is sent to Gemini. Personal profiles, ordinary chat history and personal memories are excluded.

Learning saves reusable reference notes; it does not retrain model weights. Gemini requires internet access, and account-specific quotas and billing terms apply.

name: Nila v0.2.0 — Secure Memory & Offline Automation
body:
## Nila Personal Assistant v0.2.0

This update introduces simpler Windows installation, encrypted personal storage, automatic memory and offline task automation.

### Installation & Updates
- Single-command Windows installer.
- Requirement detection and automatic prerequisite installation through WinGet.
- Standalone `nila.exe` build and PATH launcher.
- Model installation checks.
- Staged automatic updates from GitHub main-branch commits, independent of Releases.

### Privacy & Personalization
- Encrypted profiles, conversations, memories, notes, tasks and automation content.
- Windows DPAPI protection for the encryption key.
- Migration of legacy plaintext records.
- Personal profile and response-tone settings.
- Local automatic memory extraction with evidence checks.

### Offline Automation
- Scheduled local AI writing jobs.
- Notes and task summaries.
- Scheduled notes and to-dos.
- Natural-language automation drafts for user review.
- Run history and Windows login worker.
- System and Automations pages with corresponding CLI controls.

### Documentation
Updated setup, security, contribution and troubleshooting guides.

### Limitations
Scheduled jobs require the computer and Nila worker to be running. Arbitrary shell-command execution is not supported.

name: Nila v0.1.0 — Initial Release
body:
## Nila Personal Assistant v0.1.0

The first version of Nila: an Ollama-powered personal assistant with a shared Web UI and command-line experience.

### Features
- Local AI conversations powered by Ollama.
- Web interface and `nila` CLI.
- Shared conversation history.
- User-managed personal memory.
- Notes and task management.
- Streaming AI responses.
- Standalone binary build workflow.

### Recommended Model
`llama3.2:1b`

Local conversations work offline after downloading the required model.
